description: Project foundation: scaffold the Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 app INTO the existing empty repo, add gitignore and .env.local.example, define the typed domain model, transcribe the itinerary into seed data, and make the initial git commit. Everything downstream depends on this. Independent of all later FEATs (they depend on it).
steps: From d:\Personal-Projects\trip-site run: npx create-next-app@latest . --typescript --app --tailwind --eslint --src-dir --import-alias "@/*" --use-npm --no-turbopack  (target '.'; the dir already has .git and .agents — accept the non-empty-dir prompt; do NOT let it reinit git).
Edit .gitignore to ensure `.env*.local` is ignored (create-next-app already adds `.env*` patterns — verify `.env.local` is covered and that `.env.local.example` is NOT ignored).

Create .env.local.example with placeholder values and a comment per variable: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, EDITOR_PASSWORD. Also add NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY if the map needs a client-exposed key — document the tradeoff in a comment (referrer-restricted key is safe to expose).

Create src/lib/types.ts with TypeScript types for: Trip, Day, RouteLeg, Stop, Place, Person (with RsvpStatus), Expense (payer + participants + amount), BudgetItem (category, priced boolean), DriverRotation entry, ChecklistItem, VaultDocument, WeatherCard, OpenDecision, Photo. Use string IDs and ISO date strings.

Create src/lib/seed/trip-seed.ts transcribing d:\Personal-Projects\_itinerary_extracted.txt EXACTLY: 5 days with dates (Sun Dec 27 -> Thu Dec 31, Jan 1 checkout), overnights South Rim/San Diego/LA/SF x2; legs Tempe->Sedona->South Rim 270mi ~4.5-5hr (125mi+145mi sub-legs), South Rim->San Diego 504mi ~8.5-10hr (5:30am), San Diego->Griffith 128mi ~2.5-4hr, LA->SF via I-5 380mi ~6-7.5hr; ~1,282 intercity mi total, ~21.4hr; stops Sedona, Mather Point, Rim Trail, Hermit Road, Balboa Park, Griffith Observatory, Golden Gate, Palace of Fine Arts, Ferry Building, Chinatown, North Beach; costs $35/vehicle (7 days), possible $100 non-US-resident NPS fee, free Balboa grounds + Griffith building; seasonal/road warnings (24-48h forecast/road check, NPS winter gear list, Hermit Road Dec-Feb <22ft, rotate only rested drivers, no Big Sur detour, NYE fireworks not confirmed); 3 open decisions (drive whole route?, whole-trip budget, Jan 1 return leg); seed 4 adults placeholder people.

Set src/app/page.tsx to a minimal placeholder that imports the seed (so the type+seed are exercised by the build); configure next.config.ts image remotePatterns to allow the eventual Supabase storage host comment (leave permissive-but-noted).
Stage everything and make the initial commit: `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: scaffold trip-planning app foundation and seed data"`.
acceptance_criteria: Creating a throwaway .env.local then running `git status --ignored` shows it ignored; .env.local.example appears as a tracked/untracked (NOT ignored) file. Delete the throwaway .env.local afterward.
src/lib/seed/trip-seed.ts contains all 5 days with the exact mileage and drive-time figures from the document.
verification: cd d:\Personal-Projects\trip-site; npm run lint; npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build
findings:
DONE. Scaffolded with create-next-app into a temp dir then moved files (excluding its .git) into the repo, because create-next-app refuses to target a dir containing .agents even with --yes. Stack actually installed: Next.js 16.4.6, React 19.3.0, TypeScript 5, Tailwind v4 (4.3.3) via @tailwindcss/turbopack (NOT PostCSS — the Next 16 app-tw template has no postcss.config/tailwind.config; Tailwind is wired through next.config.ts turbopack rules + `@import "tailwindcss"` in src/app/globals.css). `next build` runs Turbopack by default in Next 16; the --no-turbopack flag does not apply at scaffold time. Do not add a postcss.config — it would conflict.

DOMAIN MODEL — src/lib/types.ts exports interfaces: Trip, Day, RouteLeg, Stop (StopKind union: meal|sightseeing|activity|checkin|departure|flex), Place (lat/lng are number|null until geocoded), Person (RsvpStatus: yes|no|maybe|pending; canDrive:boolean; isAdult:boolean), Expense (payerId + participantIds[] + amount + currency + category), BudgetItem (category, priced:boolean, amount:number|null), DriverRotation (dayId, optional legId, driverId, approved:boolean), ChecklistItem, VaultDocument (url:string|null), WeatherCard, OpenDecision (resolved:boolean, optional resolution), Photo (url:string|null). ISODate = string alias (YYYY-MM-DD). All IDs are stable string slugs; dates ISO strings.

SEED — src/lib/seed/trip-seed.ts exports named consts: `trip: Trip`, `places: Place[]`, `people: Person[]` (4 adult placeholders person-1..4, rsvp 'pending', avatarColor hex), `budgetItems: BudgetItem[]`, `weatherCards: WeatherCard[]`, `openDecisions: OpenDecision[]`. There is NO default export. trip.id = 'az-to-sf-2025'. trip.days has 6 entries: day-1..day-5 plus day-checkout (dayNumber 6, overnight null, date 2026-01-01). Leg ids: leg-1a (Tempe->Sedona 125mi ~2hr), leg-1b (Sedona->South Rim 145mi ~2.5-3hr), leg-2 (South Rim->San Diego 504mi ~8.5-10hr), leg-3 (San Diego->Griffith 128mi ~2.5-4hr), leg-4 (LA->SF via I-5 380mi ~6-7.5hr). trip.totalIntercityMiles=1282, trip.totalDrivingHours=21.4. Place ids used by stops: tempe, sedona, south-rim, mather-point, rim-trail, hermit-road, san-diego, balboa-park, griffith-observatory, los-angeles, san-francisco, golden-gate, palace-of-fine-arts, ferry-building, chinatown, north-beach. Park entry $35 priced; $100 non-resident fee unpriced; Balboa grounds & Griffith building amount 0 (free). 3 open decisions. 3 weather cards (Grand Canyon 24-48h check, Day-2 driving-day driver rotation, SF NYE fireworks not confirmed).

ENV — .env.local.example committed with placeholders + per-var comments: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (referrer-restricted, exposed-key tradeoff documented), NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (server-only), EDITOR_PASSWORD (server-only). .gitignore env rule rewritten to `.env` + `.env.*` + `!.env.local.example` so the example stays tracked while all other env files are ignored.

next.config.ts: images.remotePatterns allows https **.supabase.co /storage/v1/object/public/** (kept permissive, noted to tighten to exact project host later). cacheComponents + partialPrefetching are enabled by the scaffold — leave them.

page.tsx is a placeholder that imports the seed to exercise types in the build; replace it when building the segmented shell. layout.tsx uses Next 16 `LayoutProps<"/">` typed props and metadata title/description already set.

VERIFICATION (mock mode, no .env.local): npm run lint PASS (exit 0), npx tsc --noEmit PASS (exit 0), npm run build PASS (exit 0, routes / and /_not-found static). git check-ignore confirms .env.local ignored and .env.local.example NOT ignored.
